description: This is an integration test script for verifying MQTT connection functionality in the Python SDK of AWS IoT, involving multi-threaded publish/subscribe operations and validation of message exchange.

classes.name: callbackUnit
classes.description: Handles message callbacks for MQTT subscriptions, storing received messages in a set.

classes.name: runFunctionUnit
classes.description: Manages publishing messages in a thread, supporting sync and async MQTT publish methods.

methods.name: callbackUnit.__init__
methods.description: Initializes callback unit with a message set and API type.

methods.name: callbackUnit.messageCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked upon message receipt; adds message payload to internal set.

methods.name: callbackUnit.getInternalSet
methods.description: Returns the set of received messages.

methods.name: runFunctionUnit.__init__
methods.description: Initializes publishing manager with API type and message set.

methods.name: runFunctionUnit.threadPublish
methods.description: Publishes a specified number of messages to a topic at a given TPS, handling both sync and async modes.

methods.name: runFunctionUnit._performPublish
methods.description: Performs the actual publish operation based on API type.
